div.p: This case-insensitive code system http://iehr.ai/fhir/ie/core/CodeSystem/ie-core-v2-0203 defines the following codes:

tr.td: Irish Health Practitioner Regulation Agency Registration Number

An Irish Medical Council (Imc) registration number assigned to a practitioner for each profession in which they are registered. Practitioners registered in more than one profession have one registration number for each profession.
Department of the Environment, Climate and Communications Eircode associated with a place.
Company Registration Number (CRN) assigned by Companies Registration Office Ireland (CRO) to a registered company.
Health Service Provider Identifier (HPI) assigned by HSE.
Medical Card/GP Visit Cards - General Medical Service (GMS) in an Irish context.
Drugs Payment Scheme (DPS) in an Irish context.
Health Amendment Act (HAA) in an Irish context.
Long Term Illness (LTI) in an Irish context.

description.value: Additional concept codes for identifier type defined for use in an Irish context. These are additional identifier type codes to the HL7 International code set and suitable for use with Irish identifiers and may be used in HL7 V2.x identifier representations.
